test.name: /research slash command triggers the orchestrator
test.description: The /research [question] form is an explicit trigger listed in the skill description. The user is handing off a specific research question to be driven through the full GPS workflow.
test.xfail_reason: research is bypassed entirely -- skills_invoked shows question-selection, research-plan, search-full-text and search-external-sites with research absent, and the inline work exhausts max_tool_calls. Same mechanism as 001/004/012/013/014. Remove when #2927 narrows project-status's description and the test activates research 3/3.
